title: Community Amateur Sports Clubs detailed guidance notes
text:
The CASC scheme was introduced in April 2002. It has enabled many local amateur sports clubs to register with HMRC and benefit from a range of tax reliefs.

 This information gives CASCs access to the most up to date information available about their tax obligations and any reliefs available to them.
changeNote: Section '4.1 Individual donations' of the 'Community Amateur Sports Clubs: detailed guidance notes' has been updated to say you cannot donate to a CASC through the Payroll Giving scheme, and a link to how else individuals can donate has been added.
